composites.name: millard_fba_bridge
composites.description:
v2ecoli-pdmp Phase 1 FBA-BRIDGE composite — couples the Millard 2017 kinetic
ODE (central carbon + energy metabolism, via pbg-copasi CopasiUTCProcess) with
v2ecoli's bulk store (via v2ecoli.steps.fba_bridge.FBABridge). Two solvers
in one PB composite, exchanging state at a documented seam.

STATUS: BRIDGE PROCESS BUILT + UNIT-TESTED. Standalone bridge works (see
tests/test_fba_bridge.py — 8 passing tests: mM<->count round-trip, mapping
load, direction modes, diagnostics). A coupled-pilot RUN of Millard + Bridge
reaches end-to-end (25 shared metabolites translated each step) but the
COPASI solver currently produces NaN at t=0.2s when the bridge fires before
Millard's first integration step. Open follow-up: ensure bridge interval >
Millard interval, or convert bridge from Step to Process with a defined
schedule. See planned_runs.millard-fba-bridge-pilot for the workaround.

Full coupling to v2ecoli's Metabolism process (the kFBA solver consuming the
bridge-translated bulk pool) remains DEFERRED — Metabolism requires the full
WCM context (cache, partition allocator, bulk loaders, unique stores) and is
a substantially larger lift than the bridge itself. The bridge is the
prerequisite; integration is the next Phase 1 milestone.

bridge_mapping.description: Millard <-> v2ecoli species name mapping (curated for ~25 shared central-carbon metabolites).

cell_volume_L.description: E. coli cell volume in liters used for mM <-> molecule-count conversion.

composites.name: millard2017_metabolism
composites.description:
Standalone Millard et al. 2017 kinetic ODE of E. coli central carbon and energy
metabolism (BioModels MODEL1505110000), wrapped as a process-bigraph composite
via pbg-copasi's CopasiUTCProcess. The model has 77 species, 68 reactions, 3
compartments. Baseline composite for the v2ecoli-pdmp Phase 1 study
(pdmp-01-metabolism-ode); first investigation-side use of pbg-copasi.

Calibrated reference state (per Millard 2017 Fig 2): K-12 MG1655 on M9
minimal medium + glucose, dilution rate 0.1 h^-1, pH 7.0, 37C, pO2 > 20%.
Steady-state should match the published reference fluxes within solver
tolerance.

model_source.description: Path to the Millard 2017 SBML (relative to workspace root).

time.description: Duration per process update in model time units (seconds).

composites.name: millard_lqr
composites.description:
v2ecoli-pdmp Phase 1: Millard 2017 ODE + simplified scalar LQR outer
controller. The LQR drives a biomass-proxy growth-rate estimate toward
the Phase 0 M9-glucose reference μ(t) ensemble mean (real data from
64-replicate baseline).

Scope (proof of concept):
  - 1-state continuous-time LQR (closed-form Riccati solution for the
    scalar system ẋ = a x + b u)
  - Reads reference μ(t) from v2ecoli/data/phase0_glucose_mu_ref.npy
  - Computes tracking error + control signal per tick
  - LOGS the control signal (does NOT yet feed it back into Millard's
    reaction rates — closed-loop wiring is a follow-up; needs either a
    CopasiUTCProcess parameter-mutation feature OR a per-tick model
    rebuild wrapper)

This composite ships the LQR algebra + logging + Phase 0 reference
consumption. The `lqr-growth-rate-tracking` primary test in pdmp-01
can be evaluated against the logged tracking_err once the closed-loop
step is wired.

composites.name: baseline
composites.description: 55-process partitioned whole-cell E. coli model — upstream-parity architecture

transcript_initiation_mode.description: Phase-2 jump-process opt-in for transcription initiation. 'discrete' (default, legacy): multinomial event distribution with exact Σ N_i = n_target. 'poisson': per-promoter Poisson(n_target · p_i) tau-leap.

polypeptide_initiation_mode.description: Phase-2 jump-process opt-in for translation initiation. Same dispatch as transcript_initiation_mode but for PolypeptideInitiation; ribosome activation per protein becomes per-protein Poisson(n_target · p_i) tau-leap instead of one global multinomial draw.

ppgpp_regulation.description: Enable ppGpp-mediated regulation of transcription initiation (ppgpp-initiation step). On by default.

trna_attenuation.description: Enable tRNA transcriptional attenuation (trna-attenuation-config step). Off by default.

supercoiling.description: Enable DNA supercoiling dynamics (dna-supercoiling-step + dna_supercoiling_listener). Off by default.

mass_conservation.description: Enable the opt-in runtime mass-conservation check (ecoli-mass-conservation step). Off by default — the residual is not yet calibrated, so it warns each tick.

emitter.description: Observation sink for the internal 'emitter' step: parquet (hive-partitioned column store, default), sqlite (persistent time-series db), xarray (in-memory labelled arrays), or null (global_time only).

composites.name: colony
composites.description: Multi-cell colony — whole-cell E. coli agents embedded in a pymunk 2D physics environment via the EcoliWCM bridge.

seed.description: Base RNG seed; per-cell seed is offset by cell index.

cache_dir.description: Path to the ParCa cache directory.

n_cells.description: Number of initial cells in the colony.

config.title: v2ecoli colony — agent positions + mass over time

composites.name: parca
composites.description: ParCa parameter-calculation pipeline — the 9-step fit (initialize → input_adjustments → … → final_adjustments) that produces sim_data. Structural document; run via the v2ecoli-parca CLI / build_parca_composite (which load the KnowledgeBase raw_data).

debug.description: Run Steps in debug mode (extra validation/logging).

cache_dir.description: Optional cache directory passed to BasalSpecsStep.

composites.name: millard_pdmp_baseline
composites.description: Whole-cell E. coli composite with v2ecoli's tFBA Metabolism replaced by the Millard 2017 ODE + multi-state LQR controller + FBA-bridge. Phase 1 PDMP milestone: runnable end-to-end; metabolism writeback to WCM bulk is NOT yet wired (separate `central_metabolite_counts` store).

tick_s.description: Millard / LQR / bridge update interval in seconds

backend.description: ODE integrator backend for the Millard substep. 'basico' uses COPASI (full LQR support); 'jax' uses the JIT-compiled Diffrax port (faster at loose tols; no LQR yet).

with_ref_growth.description: Enable the reference-growth driver — scaffold that drives precursor pools to compensate for the Millard ODE's missing biomass equation. See `ref_growth_flux_source` for the two flux modes.

ref_growth_flux_source.description: Driver flux mode (only used when with_ref_growth=True). 'proportional' scales pools at μ=2.44e-4/s — teleonomic but moves cm_final only ~2 fg of the 187 fg gap because precursor turnover (~1.8M ATP/s) is ~1000× larger. 'measured_kfba' injects at constant per-second rates measured from a 600 s kFBA-baseline run (scripts/sample_kfba_precursor_fluxes.py → .pbg/runs/kfba-precursor-fluxes.json); top rates: GLT 5413/s, ATP 1640/s, UTP 803/s, TTP 787/s.

transcript_initiation_mode.description: Phase-2 jump-process opt-in for transcription initiation. 'discrete' (default, legacy): multinomial event distribution with exact Σ N_i = n_target — bit-identical to baseline. 'poisson': per-promoter Poisson(n_target · p_i) tau-leap; each promoter becomes an independent continuous-time jump process whose per-tick marginal Phase-3 inference can integrate against. Resource cap is the actual inactive-RNAP pool, not the discrete-time target (avoids 12% asymmetric-truncation undercount).

polypeptide_initiation_mode.description: Phase-2 jump-process opt-in for translation initiation. Same dispatch as transcript_initiation_mode but for PolypeptideInitiation; ribosome activation per protein becomes per-protein Poisson(n_target · p_i) tau-leap with the resource cap pinned to min(30S, 50S) instead of the discrete-time target.

ref_growth_feedback_tau_s.description: Feedback smoothing time-constant for the consumption_matched ref-growth driver. ``1.0`` (default) keeps the legacy tight per-tick controller — the driver fully compensates last tick's variance, so the PDMP ensemble's per-tick jump-process variance is invisible at cell_mass. Larger values smooth the consumption estimate (EMA) so per-tick stochasticity manifests in pool counts and downstream in mass; the long-run mean still tracks the kFBA-measured growth rate. Try 60 s for a 1-minute-window controller.

ref_growth_feedback_period_ticks.description: Sprint-8 sparse-injection knob for the consumption_matched ref-growth driver. ``1`` (default) acts every tick. Larger values decimate the controller — it acts every Nth tick, compensating the cumulative consumption with a period-scaled target injection. Pools drift open-loop between corrections, letting per-tick Poisson variance manifest in the PDMP ensemble. Bypasses the EMA when > 1 (one knob at a time).

transcript_init_prob_scale.description: Phase-3 sprint-7 ABC-SMC knob. In poisson mode, multiplies the per-promoter initiation rate by this scalar before sampling. Default 1.0 reproduces the unperturbed sampler; values away from 1.0 produce ensembles at distinguishable parameter settings for the ABC-SMC inference stub. Only effective when transcript_initiation_mode='poisson'.

polypeptide_init_prob_scale.description: Phase-3 sprint-10 ABC-SMC knob, mirror of transcript_init_prob_scale on the translation side. Only effective when polypeptide_initiation_mode='poisson'.

composites.name: millard_fba_bridge_harness
composites.description: Whole-cell E. coli baseline (real tFBA ecoli-metabolism) with the Millard 2017 central-carbon ODE wired in as a flux SOURCE: the Millard fluxes are mapped+converted by fba-flux-coupler into pinned_flux_targets that ecoli-metabolism hard-pins before its LP solve. Integration climax of the FBA-bridge flux-pin feature.

tick_s.description: Millard / coupler update interval in seconds

coefficient.description: Scalar coefficient applied by FBAFluxCoupler when converting a Millard flux (mM/s) into an FBA reaction-flux bound.

composites.name: parsimony-ecoli
composites.description: 3D structural model of an E. coli cell: reads a v2ecoli molecular state and packs it into an interactive 3D scene with pbg-parsimony (parsimony engine). Output (pack.json + ingredient sidecar) renders in the bundled 3D webapp.

top_n.description: How many of the most-abundant protein monomers to include (AlphaFold-modelled), beyond the curated assemblies.

scale.description: Abundance scale applied to copy numbers (1.0 = full abundance; lower = lighter/faster).

state_source.description: 'snapshot' (saved v2ecoli state, fast) or 'live' (run the baseline composite).

composites.name: biological
composites.description: Biologically-organized whole-cell E. coli model. Runs the exact same 55-process simulation as baseline (bit-identical results) but relabels the store hierarchy into cellular compartments and molecular classes — cell/molecules, cell/observables, environment/…, machinery/…, clock/… — so the bigraph reads as biology rather than plumbing.
